what: Re-check of Agent B's finding: /v1/quote/deposit crashed on a partial registry. Fix: ops@fe341ac. Run on the local validator (no devnet use), GET /v1/quote/deposit?usdc=10000000, each registry variant on a fresh server on port 8911.
pre_fix_code: ops@587d518 (copy used for the original finding)

results.fixed: 200, expected_shares 31161, lp_fee 30 from the pool account (chain)

results.pre_fix: 502 'The number NaN cannot be converted to a BigInt because it is not an integer'
results.fixed: 200, expected_shares 32350, lp_fee 30 read from the pool account, not the registry

results.registry: pools listed without seed provenance (lp_fee_bps present)
results.fixed: 200, expected_shares 32662, price_source 'no seed record in the registry; price = current pool reserves'

results.registry: pools without seed and no lp_fee_bps

results.fixed: 409 'registry has no fixture_amm.program_id or usdc.mint; run scripts/amm/seed-pools.ts for this cluster'

results.registry: fixture_amm.program_id with no pools on chain
results.fixed: 409 'no fixture_amm pool on local for OPENAI, ... (program 1111...2); run scripts/amm/seed-pools.ts'

verdict: Closed. No crash; missing registry data gives a clear 409; a missing lp_fee_bps no longer matters because the fee is read from the pool account; a good registry quotes. expected_shares differs between runs because the split follows live mainnet sell_now weights.
note: The fixed response's packing hint still says 4 transactions; the SDK packs by bytes and account locks (devnet run 4 used 2), and the hint itself says the SDK has the final say.
